request._comment: Transit parameter, consumed by this capacity. It may arrive as a value or as a transit reference; the contract declares only its name and schema (/root/llm/schema/request), and it is read through the parameter resolver.

response._comment: Transit result, consumed by the caller (/root/llm/schema/response). Never persisted by this capacity.

#adapt_request.role: Build the Scaleway Generative APIs Chat Completions request from the canonical request.

transformation_contract.morphing: A canonical inference request becomes a Scaleway chat-completion request.
notes: request.messages -> body.messages preserving role, content and order.
request.requirements.reasoning -> body.reasoning_effort when supported by the selected Scaleway model.
When request.output.format is absent or 'text', structured response_format is omitted.
This capacity targets Scaleway Serverless Generative APIs. A dedicated deployment would require its deployment-specific base URL and is not implicitly substituted.

#execute.role: Execute the Scaleway chat-completion request asynchronously.

transformation_contract.morphing: A Scaleway chat-completion request becomes a Scaleway chat-completion response.
A Scaleway response becomes a canonical inference response.
notes: For format 'text', response.output.content preserves that content.
For format 'json' or 'json_schema', parse the generated JSON string into response.output.content.
response.output.format is the effective canonical output format.

#root.role: Adapt a canonical LLM request to the Scaleway OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API, execute it asynchronously, and normalize the result.

invariants: The request and the response are transit values: no Matter is read, written or created, and nothing is persisted.

A transient failure of the provider (a rate limit 429, an overload 529, a server error 5xx, a request timeout 408, a broken connection) is asked again up to three times, waiting longer each time (the Retry-After of the provider when it gives one); any other error is returned at once.
transformation_contract.morphing: A canonical inference request becomes a canonical inference response produced through Scaleway.

objective.name: infer.scaleway
objective.description: Execute a canonical inference request through Scaleway Generative APIs and return a canonical inference response.
